## Welcome!

This workshop introduces R programming for biomedical data analysis, designed for researchers at IISc Bio Engineering.

### Schedule Overview

| Day | Date | Theme |
|-----|------|-------|
| **Day 1** | Jan 6 | R Foundations |
| **Day 2** | Jan 7 | Statistics & Analysis |
| **Day 3** | Jan 8 | Reporting & Communication |

### What You'll Learn

- **Day 1:** RStudio, data types, importing data, tidyverse basics, dplyr, ggplot2
- **Day 2:** Descriptive statistics, hypothesis testing, t-tests, ANOVA, regression
- **Day 3:** Publication figures, Quarto reports, reproducibility, mini-project

### Prerequisites

- Laptop with R (≥4.3) and RStudio installed
- No prior programming experience required

### Getting Help

- Raise your hand during sessions
- Use the workshop Slack/chat channel
- Check the [Quick Reference](handouts/quick_reference.qmd)

---

**Let's get started!**
